site_name: Ascent ATL1, 4905 North Point Pkwy, Alpharetta
year_evidence_quote: Originally built and occupied by cell phone giant Blackberry in 2009, the 185,000-square-foot data center sits on a 38-acre site at 4905 N. Point Parkway in Alpharetta, Ga.
year_site_match: The article gives the exact street address (4905 N. Point Parkway, Alpharetta, Ga.), the 38-acre site (same acreage as the ATL1 campus in the 2018 Commercial Search article), 185,000 SF and 7 MW (same figures Bisnow gives for 4905 North Point Parkway), and says St. Louis-based Ascent will continue to provide facilities management at the site.
verification: The page supports 2009, not the claimed 2018. REBusinessOnline (2022-08-15, reached from the Bisnow article's attribution via the site's own search page) states retrospectively that the data center at this exact address was built and occupied by Blackberry in 2009. This is a trade-press retrospective, not a contemporaneous opening notice, so I rate it medium under rule (c) and label the basis reference_work. The claimed 2018 rests on Commercial Search (2018-06-27) calling ATL1 Ascent's 'newly completed data center' on a 38-acre Alpharetta campus with no street address; read against the 2009 statement, that is most plausibly Ascent's refit and first marketing of an existing building (inference, not stated on any page), so it is not the first building's start. Caveats: (1) the 2009 sentence combines 'built and occupied' in one phrase and the article does not separately state the building's original use, though the grammatical subject is 'the 185,000-square-foot data center'; (2) the quote was reassembled from consecutive fragments returned by the fetch tool, which caps quoted spans, so the punctuation should be spot-checked against the live page; (3) no government record (assessor year built) was opened to corroborate. The Ascent press release page carries no date and no address. Bisnow (2025-10-12) confirms the address, 185K SF, 7 MW in 2022, and the 2022 and 2025 sales but gives no build or opening year.

lead.notes: Article dated 2018-06-27 calls ATL1 a 'newly completed data center' on a 38-acre campus in Alpharetta but gives no street address or opening statement, and the building was acquired by Ascent in 2017 per search results (not opened). Bisnow (2025-10-12, opened) confirms a 7 MW data center at 4905 North Point in 2022 and a 2025 sale to GI Partners. The tie to this address is by name (ATL1 = 4905 North Point per directories) so I rate it low; 2018 is likely a conversion or completion year for Ascent, not necessarily the first building's start.
